summary.result: CMW aggregates showed good physical and mechanical properties with having specific gravity over 2.65, absorption less than 1%, and abrasion ratio below 20%.
summary.background: The CMW was collected from Sabuk region.
summary.method: Fine and coarse aggregates from CMW were prepared by using a crusher and separating debris with #4 sieve.
